subject: PO field mapping + billing cadence for Sparrow Retail onboarding
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen@sparrowretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sparrow Retail Finance <ap@sparrowretail.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor onboarding — payment cadence and PO requirements

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the walkthrough last week. We're ready to start the vendor onboarding for Sparrow Retail and want to align on a few items before we kick off PO issuance: 

- Sparrow typically pays Net 45 but we'd like to request Net 30 for the first two invoices while we validate the billing lines. After that, standard Net 45.
- We offer a 1.5% early-pay discount if invoices are paid within 10 days — would Redwood be open to an early-pay option (Net 10 @ 1.5%) for a small discount?
- Our PO system requires the following fields on the invoice: PO Number, Line Item Code (6-digit), Ship-to Location code, and GL cost center. We included an export of our PO schema in the attachment.

Can you confirm Redwood's preferred remit and whether you can map our PO fields to your invoice template (we're okay with a small one-off mapping step on your side)? Also please send any onboarding forms we need to complete on Sparrow's side (e.g., tax forms, vendor setup sheet).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — their merchandising season is tight and they want to enable POs by the 21st.

Best,
Ellen Park
Head of Procurement
Sparrow Retail
attachments: sparrow_po_schema.csv (stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen@sparrowretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — payment cadence and PO requirements

Hi Ellen,

Thanks — looping in Ben from Finance and Karthik from Ops so we can triage the PO mapping and payment terms. Quick answers up front:

- We can support a temporary Net 30 for the first two invoices, then switch to Net 45. Please flag on the first PO “ONBOARD-NET30” so Finance picks up the cadence change.
- Early-pay: Finance runs an early-pay pilot for strategic merchants. We'd need a signed agreement on the discount (1.5% for payment in 10 days). Ben, can you confirm the process for enrolling Sparrow in the early-pay program and whether 1.5% is within standard thresholds?
- PO mapping: attaching our PO field-mapping template (po-field-mapping-template.xlsx). Karthik — can your team take the Sparrow PO schema and propose a mapping back to Redwood invoice fields by EOD Thursday?

I've attached the Redwood onboarding form — please fill sections A–D (company info, remit instructions, tax forms) and return. We'll hold on enabling POs until we receive the completed form and a sample PO.

Next steps:
1) Sparrow fills and returns the onboarding PDF.
2) Sparrow sends a sample PO export (CSV) with the Line Item Codes.
3) Karthik to provide mapping and confirm any gaps.
4) Ben to confirm early-pay enrollment and send a one-page pilot agreement for signatures.

If that timeline works we'll aim to activate POs by 21 Jun.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Vendor Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood_onboarding_form.pdf, po-field-mapping-template.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen@sparrowretail.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 11:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — payment cadence and PO requirements

Hi Ellen — quick note from Finance.

We can approve the Net 30 temporary cadence and the Net 45 thereafter. On early-pay: 1.5% for Net 10 is acceptable for the pilot, subject to: 
- Signed early-pay pilot agreement (I will send a DocuSign link)
- ACH as preferred remit method (we provide payment instructions on the onboarding form)
- Completed tax paperwork (W-9 for US entities)

Please confirm you can accept ACH and attach the W-9. Also, when you return the onboarding form, put your banking details in Section D.

Ellen, I'll drop the one-page pilot agreement into DocuSign after Marissa confirms enrollment.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
attachments: (none)

From: Ellen Park <ellen@sparrowretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — payment cadence and PO requirements

Marissa/Ben — thanks for the clarity. Attached: completed onboarding form (sections A–D), a sample PO CSV, and our signed W-9. We will accept ACH; bank details included on the form.

Notes on mapping: our PO uses a six-digit product code; we've included a small legend on the CSV. If you need, we can add a human-readable description column.

Please confirm once you have the mapping and that we can proceed with POs on Net 30 (first two invoices) + Net 45 ongoing. Also, send the DocuSign link for the early-pay pilot and we'll get that back promptly.

Best,
Ellen Park
attachments: sparrow_signed_w9.pdf, sample_po_export.csv

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen@sparrowretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 16:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — payment cadence and PO requirements

Thanks Ellen — received everything and confirmed with Karthik and Finance. Summary and next steps: 

- Mapping: Karthik's team will map Sparrow's six-digit product code to Redwood's Line Item SKU field. Expect a mapping file and notes by Friday 11 Jun EOD.
- Payment terms: we'll enroll Sparrow as temporary Net 30 for first two invoices; after that invoices will default to Net 45. Please annotate the first PO with “ONBOARD-NET30”.
- Early-pay: Ben has scheduled the DocuSign for the 1.5% Net 10 pilot; you should receive it within the hour. Once signed, we'll enroll Sparrow in the next early-pay run (cutoff T+14).
- Remit: ACH ok — Redwood will verify bank details and confirm via a micro-deposit (standard ops).

I'll follow up when mapping is complete and when the pilot agreement is countersigned. Welcome to Redwood — excited to get Sparrow onboarded.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Vendor Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: (none)
